research.edition: international ablefy REST API at api.myablefy.com
research.searchCoverage: Official ablefy API at https://api.myablefy.com/api with required key and secret query parameters. GET /api/me is the swagger test-auth endpoint and pinned credential validator. Product and pricing-plan GETs are cheap catalog reads. Writes, refunds, and order creates are omitted. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved ablefy/elopage compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /me, swagger 'Test auth endpoint' and the pinned credential validator.
Native category is ecommerce (source Marketing/Productivity; Marketing is not in Rust CATEGORIES). ablefy is a digital-product sales API.
Dual query auth uses http.auth key={{apiKey}} plus http.query secret={{apiSecret}}, matching swagger key/secret query parameters.
Returns raw provider JSON under data instead of the pinned {data} wrapper.
Maps to swagger GET /api/products. Returns raw JSON under data.
Maps to swagger GET /api/products/{id}. id is a numeric path segment.
Maps to swagger POST /api/orders/{token}/cancel. Auth stays on query parameters.
